items.title: Florida opens interest-free disaster recovery loans for farmers hit by Isaias
items.summary: Florida Agriculture Commissioner Wilton Simpson announced (Oct 12) interest-free loans of up to $500,000 for farmers, ranchers and aquaculture producers with Hurricane Isaias damage in 30 Florida counties (incl. Escambia, Santa Rosa, Okaloosa), covering fences, equipment, greenhouses, buildings, debris removal and aquaculture restocking. Producers urged to photograph damage and save receipts. Program sits in a revolving state loan fund ($75M from 2023 special session + $40M more in 2025).
